name: DUNE
summary: DUNE is a long-baseline neutrino programme under construction, joining a Fermilab near-detector complex to large underground liquid-argon detectors in South Dakota. Its full far-detector physics programme is distinct from operating prototypes.
physics_targets: Leptonic CP violation and the neutrino mass ordering
detection_principle: A wide-band accelerator beam is sampled near its source and after a 1,300 km flight. Liquid-argon time projection chambers image electron and muon final states and measure calorimetric energy to compare neutrino and antineutrino oscillation spectra.
